title: Australian Flatbread with Aussie Meat Pie Filling
description: An authentic Australian recipe featuring a homemade flatbread topped with a savory meat pie filling. This classic dish is a staple of Australian cuisine.
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until softened.
Mix in your yummy seasoning (if using).
While the filling is cooking, prepare the flatbread dough by combining 2 cups of flour, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Gradually add water to the flour mixture to form a dough, then knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your flatbread slices to be.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place the flatbread slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with beaten eggs mixed with milk for a golden glaze.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Spoon the meat pie filling onto one half of each flatbread slice, then fold the other half over to create a half-moon shape.
